title: Gate G02 capability: governed requirements decomposition and first-class RTM contract
objective: Implement badf-requirements so an approved PRD baseline can be decomposed into a deterministic, bidirectionally complete RTM spanning objectives, capabilities, epics, requirements, quantified NFRs, acceptance criteria, test obligations and evidence requirements without granting G02 authority.
business_value: Prevents story-generation shortcuts and orphan requirements from entering design by making traceability, testability, NFR quantification and evidence obligations explicit before Gate G02 review.
in_scope: skills/badf-requirements/SKILL.md with RTM and external-methodology references
G02 methodology provenance for Spec Kit, requirements-clarity and security-requirement-extraction
skill registry and badf-delivery routing integration at IMPLEMENTED status
BADF-DEM-0015 / WP-2026-0028 traceability and integrity lockfile update
out_of_scope: Gate G02 approval, DESIGN_READY or next-stage authorization
implementation of badf-prd or dependence on an unmerged G01 branch
architecture, solution design or implementation planning
vendoring or executing external skill code
direct writes to main or production
acceptance_criteria: canonical RTM represents PRD objective -> capability -> epic -> requirement plus mandatory requirement -> quantified NFR overlay
every delivery path terminates through acceptance criterion -> test obligation -> evidence requirement
security/compliance-sensitive requirements require threat/compliance/privacy/abuse-case source provenance
unknown/orphan nodes, invalid edge types, duplicate identities/links, placeholders and unapproved upstream PRD baselines fail closed
requirement dependencies are known, non-self-referential and acyclic; BLOCKED dependencies produce REWORK_REQUIRED
open decisions and open blocking review findings produce REWORK_REQUIRED rather than approval
validator returns only ELIGIBLE_FOR_G02_REVIEW, REWORK_REQUIRED or fail-closed error and always reports NO_GATE_AUTHORITY
canonical template is intentionally not passable until placeholders are replaced
targeted tests, repository gate, full unittest suite and composed-tree verification pass before merge
permissions: read: public methodology sources for provenance only
no production or lifecycle gate authority

rollback.method: revert the eventual squash commit through a separate PR

note: Issue/branch use the human-facing BADF-WP-G02-001 label; the repository machine work-package identity is WP-2026-0028.
